name: White-Label PPC & Meta Ads Management
promise: Meta and Google Ads managed for your agency's clients, reported under your brand.
intro: gaa-tha provides white-label PPC and outsourced Meta and Google Ads management for US and UK agencies and brands. We build and optimize campaigns, test creative, set up Conversions API and GA4 tracking and report under your agency's name — working through partner access, so ad accounts and ad spend always stay with the client.

glance.bestFor: Agencies reselling paid media and brands that want an outsourced performance team
glance.timeline: Account audit in week one; first optimized campaigns in two to three weeks
glance.model: Paid pilot on one account, then a monthly management retainer
glance.channels: Meta Ads (Facebook, Instagram), Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube)

whatIs: White-label PPC is paid media management that an agency sells under its own brand while a partner runs the campaigns. The agency owns the client relationship and strategy conversations; the partner handles account structure, campaign builds, audiences, creative testing, bidding, tracking and reporting.

gaa-tha runs Meta and Google Ads for its own ecommerce and lead-generation clients, including campaigns across Canada for a retail client, and does the same work white-label for agencies. We are added through Meta Business Manager partner access or a Google Ads manager account, the client pays the platforms directly, and reports go out in your agency's template.
included: Account and tracking audit with a prioritized fix list
Campaign structure, audiences and budgets for Meta and Google Ads
Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube campaigns
Creative testing plans, ad copy and static or video ad production
Meta Pixel with Conversions API, GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking
Weekly optimization of bids, budgets, audiences and creative
Lead quality checks and offline conversion feedback for lead-gen clients
Reports and dashboards in your agency's branding
Monthly strategy notes you can present to the client as your own

steps.title: Access and audit
steps.text: We join through partner access, audit structure, tracking and spend, and agree KPIs such as CPA, ROAS or cost per qualified lead.

steps.title: Fix tracking
steps.text: Conversions API, GA4 and Google Ads conversions are verified before any scaling.

steps.title: Build and launch
steps.text: Campaigns, audiences and creative tests go live against an agreed budget plan.

steps.title: Optimize weekly
steps.text: Bids, budgets, audiences and creative are adjusted weekly with notes on every change.

steps.title: Report monthly
steps.text: A branded report and strategy notes ready for your client meeting.

deliverables: Creative test plan with ad copy and assets
pricing: Monthly management fee custom-quoted on platforms, number of accounts and creative volume, after a paid pilot. Ad spend is paid by the client directly to Meta and Google with no markup. International invoices, paid by bank wire (SWIFT), PayPal or card through Stripe.

faq.a: White-label PPC is paid ads management that your agency sells under its own name while a partner runs the campaigns. gaa-tha manages Meta and Google Ads for US and UK agencies, reporting in your branding and working only through you.

faq.q: Do you need ownership of the ad accounts?
faq.a: No. The client keeps ownership of the ad accounts and pays Meta and Google directly. We are added through Meta Business Manager partner access or your Google Ads manager account with only the permissions we need.

faq.q: Which KPIs do you report on?
faq.a: Whatever the client is judged on: CPA, ROAS, cost per qualified lead, MER or new-customer revenue. We agree the primary KPI during the audit and report against it every month.

faq.q: Do you also make the ad creative?
faq.a: Yes. Our in-house team produces static ads, UGC-style edits and short video ads for testing, so creative is not the bottleneck. Agencies can also supply their own creative.

faq.q: Can you work with our existing reporting tools?
faq.a: Yes. We report in your Looker Studio, AgencyAnalytics, DashThis or slide template, or build a dashboard in your branding if you do not have one.
With a paid pilot on one account: an audit, tracking fixes and a month of management. You see the change log and results before adding more accounts.
